units.source: In-editor AI assistant
units.context: In-editor AI assistant

units.source: The AI assistant works on the text you are already writing: select a passage and have it rewritten, translated or turned into a table, or ask for new content at the cursor. Unlike the __TRILIUM_PH_0__AI chat__TRILIUM_PH_1__, it does not open a conversation window, the result is previewed in place and only enters the note when you accept it.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant

units.source: Requirements__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Requirements

units.source: The assistant is only available once at least one provider is configured in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__AI / LLM__TRILIUM_PH_3__, with at least one model selected for it. Until then the toolbar entry is not shown at all.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Requirements

units.source: Accessing the AI assistant__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Accessing the AI assistant

units.source: To access the AI assistant:
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Accessing the AI assistant

units.source: Look for the __TRILIUM_PH_0__ button in the __TRILIUM_PH_1__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_2__. Press the button itself to enter the __TRILIUM_PH_3__Ask AI__TRILIUM_PH_4__ mode or press the arrow key next to it to access the quick commands and the model selection. On a phone, the button has no arrow: tapping it opens the same menu at the bottom of the screen, with __TRILIUM_PH_5__Ask AI…__TRILIUM_PH_6__ at its top, and a group such as __TRILIUM_PH_7__Translate__TRILIUM_PH_8__ opens as a page of its own.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Accessing the AI assistant

units.source: Look for __TRILIUM_PH_0__AI assistant__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or any of the __TRILIUM_PH_2__AI__TRILIUM_PH_3__-prefixed quick commands in __TRILIUM_PH_4__Slash Commands__TRILIUM_PH_5__.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Accessing the AI assistant

units.source: Press __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ctrl__TRILIUM_PH_1__+__TRILIUM_PH_2__Shift__TRILIUM_PH_3__+__TRILIUM_PH_4__K__TRILIUM_PH_5__.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Accessing the AI assistant

units.source: Select a text and choose the __TRILIUM_PH_0__AI assistant__TRILIUM_PH_1__ option in the __TRILIUM_PH_2__Note contextual menu__TRILIUM_PH_3__.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Accessing the AI assistant

units.source: Click or right-click the drag handle to the left of a paragraph and choose __TRILIUM_PH_0__AI assistant__TRILIUM_PH_1__, see __TRILIUM_PH_2__Formatting toolbar__TRILIUM_PH_3__. It offers the same items as the toolbar button, and works on the blocks that the handle shades. If the assistant is already open, it starts over on these blocks, and a response you have not inserted is dropped.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Accessing the AI assistant

units.source: In all cases the assistant also sends the text before and after the target, so that the model can tell what it is writing into: asked to __TRILIUM_PH_0__Continue writing__TRILIUM_PH_1__ or to summarize, a model that can only see the selected words is guessing at the document around them. This surrounding text is context only, it is never rewritten.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > What the assistant works on

units.source: That means a single run sends more than the passage you highlighted. See __TRILIUM_PH_0__Privacy__TRILIUM_PH_1__ for exactly what leaves your machine.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > What the assistant works on

units.source: Quick actions__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Quick actions

units.source: The arrow beside the toolbar button opens a menu of ready-made instructions, grouped by what they do.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Quick actions

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Reformat__TRILIUM_PH_1__ actions produce real Trilium content rather than plain text: __TRILIUM_PH_2__Diagram__TRILIUM_PH_3__ inserts a Mermaid diagram, __TRILIUM_PH_4__Callout__TRILIUM_PH_5__ an admonition, and __TRILIUM_PH_6__Collapsible__TRILIUM_PH_7__ a collapsible block.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Quick actions

units.source: The __TRILIUM_PH_0__Translate__TRILIUM_PH_1__ group lists the __TRILIUM_PH_2__content languages__TRILIUM_PH_3__ you have enabled, or a predefined list if no content languages are set. It can be filled from within the editor, the last entry of the submenu opens the language configuration directly.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Quick actions

units.source: Actions that need something to work on are greyed out when there is nothing to work on (for example an empty paragraph with no selection).
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Quick actions

units.source: Asking for something specific__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Asking for something specific

units.source: Choosing __TRILIUM_PH_0__Ask AI…__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (__TRILIUM_PH_2__) opens a prompt where you can describe the change in your own words, for example: "make this less formal", "add a row for 2024", "write an intro paragraph for this section". Press __TRILIUM_PH_3__Enter__TRILIUM_PH_4__ or the __TRILIUM_PH_5__ send button to run it.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Asking for something specific

units.source: Once a response arrives you can keep going in the same prompt, and the assistant treats it as a conversation rather than as a fresh request: after __TRILIUM_PH_0__Translate this to German__TRILIUM_PH_1__, asking for __TRILIUM_PH_2__make it shorter__TRILIUM_PH_3__ shortens the German, not the original.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Asking for something specific

units.source: Reviewing the result__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Reviewing the result

units.source: The response streams in as it is generated, and can be interrupted at any point by pressing the __TRILIUM_PH_0__Stop__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (__TRILIUM_PH_2__) button; whatever arrived before that stays usable.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Reviewing the result

units.source: Nothing is written into the note until you say so. The review offers:
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Reviewing the result

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Result__TRILIUM_PH_1__, which displays the response as it will be inserted.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Reviewing the result

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Changes__TRILIUM_PH_1__, which displays an inline diff against the original, with insertions and deletions marked. When the model rewrote the passage rather than editing it, the review opens on __TRILIUM_PH_2__Result__TRILIUM_PH_3__ instead: a diff of two texts with little in common is harder to read than the answer itself.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Reviewing the result

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Try again__TRILIUM_PH_1__ (__TRILIUM_PH_2__), to re-run the same instruction.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Reviewing the result

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Replace__TRILIUM_PH_1__, which substitutes the original passage
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Reviewing the result

units.source: __TRILIUM_PH_0__Insert below__TRILIUM_PH_1__, which keeps the original and adds the response after it.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Reviewing the result

units.source: Trilium also reports the model that produced it, the tokens consumed and, for providers that report it, the price.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Reviewing the result

units.source: If you ask for a correction and there is nothing to correct, the assistant will indicate it instead of showing a blank diff.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Reviewing the result

units.source: Choosing the model__TRILIUM_PH_0__
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Choosing the model

units.source: The bottom of the quick actions menu shows which model the assistant runs on, and lets you pick another from the models you selected in __TRILIUM_PH_0__Options__TRILIUM_PH_1__ → __TRILIUM_PH_2__AI / LLM__TRILIUM_PH_3__, grouped by provider.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Choosing the model

units.source: The model can also be changed while asking for something specific, or after the assistant has generated its response (i.e. if the response needs a better model).
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Choosing the model

units.source: This choice is separate from the model used by the chat, and is remembered across notes and devices. Left unset, the assistant follows the first configured provider.
units.context: In-editor AI assistant > Choosing the model
